messages.subject: Sleep parameters children (5-11yo)
parts:
Hello everyone and a happy new year!

I am using Actigraph GT3X+ accelerometers, and the study participants are children aged between 5 and 11 years. Regarding the sleep parameters, specifically anglethreshold=5 and timethreshold=5, are they appropriate for children as they might move more than adults? Some of the children used the accelerometer on the dominant wrist. Thank you!

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Sleep parameters children (5-11yo)
parts:
Did you search literature? I remember at least this study https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/34090467/
but maybe there are more studies now. Please report back if you know more studies.

Either way, I designed the algorithm to be interpretable as a description of when there is a lack of posture change. I did not intend it to be optimised for classification accuracy, because I think ability to interpret is more important than agreement with a construct that is not even defined based on posture or acceleration (neurological sleep). See also narrative in the papers.

Vincent
